topic: What if the Moon orbited at half its current distance?
scientific_scope_note: Approx. 8× lunar tidal-generating forcing is not a prediction of 8× tide heights at every shoreline; coastal response varies.

youtube_shorts.title: What If the Moon Were Twice as Close to Earth?
youtube_shorts.description:
What would happen if the Moon suddenly orbited at half its current distance? Follow a cinematic 3D thought experiment through brighter night skies, the physics of tides, and surprising effects for coastal life.

A closer Moon would exert much stronger tidal-generating forces—but that does NOT mean all ocean tides would rise by the same fixed factor. Local tides depend on coastlines and ocean dynamics.

Explore the science behind this what-if scenario.
Sources: NASA Moon facts; NOAA tides resources.
